_comment: 4-Tier Skill Tree (GDD §6.3, canon/actions.json §4.4). Common = 3 CE, Uncommon = 6 CE, Rare = 18 CE, Legendary = 54 CE. Learning requires Meditation in Care phase.

skills.name: Scavenger's Eye
skills.desc: Sharp eyes for the small things: +1 common when gathering on any tile.

skills.name: Swift Stride
skills.desc: Light on your feet: +1 base move speed.

skills.name: Sturdy Pack
skills.desc: Reinforced straps: +2 hand limit and +1 backpack item slot.

skills.name: Iron Skin
skills.desc: Toughened by thorns: ignores the first creature Bite or Raid against you each round.

skills.name: Duality Attunement
skills.desc: Resonance with the island karma: gifts and generous trades yield +1 additional Light.

skills.name: Beast Whisperer
skills.desc: The wild recognizes your soul: creature encounters treat your Light as 1 band higher.

skills.name: Master Crafter
skills.desc: Effortless craftsmanship: all recipe costs reduced by 1 Common (minimum 1).

skills.name: Shrine Keeper
skills.desc: Reverence for holy ground: building or visiting shrines grants +1 VP and clears 1 Island Rage.

skills.name: Avatar of Harmony
skills.desc: One with the living island: Giving Back grants +2 VP and heals 2 Energy.

skills.name: Island Sovereign
skills.desc: The land yields freely: gathering yields double commons and cards without exhausting the hex.
